findings: The candidate explicitly declares assumptions absent from the frozen source Questions: Java node shape, finite/acyclic/disjoint sorted inputs, node reuse and equal-value tie-break semantics.

The iterative two-pointer invariant is correct: the emitted prefix is the globally smallest sorted prefix and the next output must be one of the two current heads; attaching the remaining sorted suffix after one input is exhausted is justified.
The deterministic OpenJDK validation compiles and passes six fixed cases plus 5000 randomized oracle comparisons, including empty inputs, duplicates, negative values and original-node reuse.
The stated O(m+n) time and O(1) extra-space bounds match the actual node-reuse implementation; the only allocated result-structure helper is the dummy node.

Shared-node and cycle hazards are explicitly outside the declared in-place contract, while recursive and non-mutating variants are handled as explicit follow-up tradeoffs rather than hidden source requirements.
Both frozen source variants are covered without cross-topic knowledge pollution or fabricated project experience.
